facts.text: Davenport University offers an Employment Guarantee for qualifying programs, making students eligible for additional education benefits if they are unable to obtain employment within six months of graduation.

sources.title: Employment Guarantee | Davenport University
sources.quote: Students who meet Davenport's requirements in the following program areas will be eligible for additional education benefits if they are unable to obtain employment within six months of graduation.

facts.text: Under Davenport's Employment Guarantee, eligible graduates who are not employed within six months of graduation can receive up to a maximum of 48 undergraduate, graduate or Institute for Professional Excellence credits.

sources.title: Employment Guarantee | Davenport University
sources.quote: For students who have achieved the standards of this agreement and are not employed within six (6) months of graduation, Davenport University will offer any and all of the following items based on an assessment of student needs:

sources.title: Employment Guarantee | Davenport University
sources.quote: Up to a maximum of 48 undergraduate, graduate or Institute for Professional Excellence credits, and does not include the cost of textbooks, course fees, residence hall or living accommodations, or fees for taking certification tests.
